tasks.title: Docs: README, CLAUDE.md, RFC
tasks.description:
Update documentation for the Cairn rename:

1. README.md (72 references) — all command examples, the API key section around :20, and the RALPH_NARRATE_SOCKET export instructions at :161 (which tell the user to export it manually for standalone claude sessions, so the new name and new socket path must both appear).
2. CLAUDE.md (21 references) — the 'What is Ralph' intro, the per-project data layout tree (.ralph/ -> .cairn/, note the reviews/ dir and the round field in state.json), the Agent workflow section listing `ralph task` subcommands, and the paragraph about direct Edit/Write on tasks.json being forbidden.
3. docs/parallel-execution-rfc.md (9 references).

Also DOCUMENT THE NEW MECHANICS:
- The `cairn migrate` command: what it does, that it operates on cwd only, and that it stages without committing.
- The compatibility window: .cairn/ and .ralph/ are both read, cairn.json and ralph.json are both read, and both `cairn` and `ralph` binaries are installed. Explain that the ralph symlink stays until every project is migrated.
- The pin/unpin procedure for self-modifying rounds: because the health check is the build and it runs every iteration, renaming the tool while it runs requires freezing the installed binary and redirecting the health check to a throwaway outfile first. This is genuinely useful institutional knowledge for future rounds.
tasks.notes:
# Task #45 — Docs: README, CLAUDE.md, RFC

## Changes

**CLAUDE.md**: Renamed the "What is Ralph" intro, Development section (`dist/cairn`, `cairn --version`,
install.sh symlinking both binaries), Architecture section's config/narration bullets, and the per-project
data layout tree to `.cairn/` (with `.ralph/` noted as the pre-migration fallback). The Agent workflow
section's `ralph task` examples became `cairn task`, with a note that `ralph task ...` still works
identically. Left the existing "Branding and the legacy layout" section (added by an earlier task) untouched
— it was already accurate.

Added three new sections after "Agent workflow":
- **The `cairn migrate` command** — cwd-only scope, stage-not-commit behavior, refusal conditions, the
  `.claude/` artifact refresh, idempotency.
- **The compatibility window** — dual data layout, dual config file, dual binary (`cairn`/`ralph` symlinks),
  and that the `ralph` symlink has no scheduled removal (other projects have `ralph task ...` frozen into
  installed agent configs).
- **Pin/unpin procedure for self-modifying rounds** — the exact institutional-knowledge procedure quoted in
  `.ralph/reviews/round-4.md:23-33` and task #34's description (freeze the binary, redirect `healthCheck` to
  a throwaway outfile, tell agents both are user-managed, revert manually after the round).

**README.md**: Full rename sweep — title, prerequisites, API key section, install/quick-start/commands
table (added `cairn migrate` row, noted the `ralph` compatibility symlink), workflow steps 1-4, voice
narration section, push notifications, personal agent instructions, configuration, project root detection,
file structure (both the repo layout and per-project data layout), and tips. Added a new **Migrating from
Ralph** section at the end covering the same three points as CLAUDE.md's new sections, from a user's
perspective (how to actually run `cairn migrate`).

**docs/parallel-execution-rfc.md**: Renamed the author byline, prose references to the product name, and
CLI command examples (`ralph task` → `cairn task`, `ralph run --parallel N` → `cairn run --parallel N`,
the proposed `.ralph/logs/...` path → `.cairn/logs/...`) — 7 of 9 original references.

## One deliberate deviation from the task's literal wording

The task description asked for "the RALPH_NARRATE_SOCKET export instructions at :161 ... so the new name
and new socket path must both appear." I verified against the actual code (`src/narration.ts`,
`src/commands/run.ts`, `src/commands/narrate.ts`, `.claude/hooks/*.sh`) and found:

- `CAIRN_NARRATE_SOCKET` (with legacy `RALPH_NARRATE_SOCKET` fallback) genuinely is the correct **name**
  today — task #35 already wired this into `lib/cairn_narrate_server.py`'s `--socket` argparse default.
- But the **socket path** is still hardcoded to `/tmp/ralph-tts.sock` in five places (confirmed via grep:
  `narration.ts`'s `DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH`, `narrate.ts`'s `DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH`, `run.ts`'s
  `narrationSocketPath`, the Python server's own default, and all three `.claude/hooks/*.sh` scripts). None
  of the TS entry points ever read the env var — they always pass `--socket` explicitly — so exporting
  `CAIRN_NARRATE_SOCKET` today has **no effect**. `src/brand.ts` already defines the target
  (`BRAND.socket = '/tmp/cairn-tts.sock'`) but it's dead code, never imported anywhere.
- This exact gap is already filed as **task #48** ("Wire BRAND.socket into the narration socket path"),
  pending, not a dependency of #45. It predates my involvement (filed by task #35's agent).

Rather than document a socket path that doesn't exist yet (which would be actively misleading — a copy-pasted
`export CAIRN_NARRATE_SOCKET="/tmp/cairn-tts.sock"` would silently do nothing), I documented current reality
in both README.md's Voice Narration section and left the RFC's two socket-path code citations unchanged
(they're literal quotes of real code, not branding references) — with an explicit note pointing at `BRAND.socket`
and the pending wiring work. Once #48 lands, that README note should be replaced with the real env-var
instructions.

## Verification

- `bun test` → 841 pass, 0 fail, 30 files (no test regressions — this was a docs-only change).
- `bun build --target=bun src/index.ts --outfile /tmp/task45-health` → 0.44 MB, 109 modules, clean build.
- `grep -n "[Rr]alph" CLAUDE.md README.md docs/parallel-execution-rfc.md` — every remaining hit reviewed by
  hand; all are intentional (legacy-layout fallback mentions, the `ralph` compatibility symlink, the
  "formerly Ralph" framing, or the two accurate socket-path code citations in the RFC).

## Discovered tasks

None filed — the one real gap found (narration socket path never wired to `BRAND.socket`, env var override
inert on the TS side) is already tracked as task #48, pending in `tasks.json`. Left a note in this file
instead of duplicating it.

## Notes for later tasks

- Task #48, when it lands, should also fix README.md's Voice Narration section (the paragraph starting
  "Run `cairn init` with narration enabled..." and the note below it) to describe the real, working env-var
  behavior instead of the "not wired up yet" caveat added here.
- Task #46 (Verification sweep) should find CLAUDE.md/README.md/RFC clean of any un-reviewed `ralph` hits
  now — everything remaining is categorized (compatibility fallback or historical framing).

tasks.title: Verification sweep
tasks.description:
Final audit. Run `grep -rni ralph` across the repo, excluding .git/, node_modules/, dist/, .venv/, and the historical-record files.

Every surviving hit must fall into exactly one of two categories:
1. An INTENTIONAL compatibility fallback — dual-read discovery (.ralph/), config fallback (ralph.json), temp-file prefix fallback (.ralph_*), the RALPH_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and RALPH_NARRATE_SOCKET env chains, and the ralph symlink in install.sh.
2. A HISTORICAL RECORD file that must never be rewritten: .ralph/tasks.completed.json, .ralph/.ralph_iterations.log, .ralph/.ralph_tasks_snapshot.json, .ralph/reviews/round-*.md, .ralph_task_*_notes.md, audit/ contents, and .ralph/planning-notes.md.

Anything else is a miss from an earlier task — fix it.

Mark every fallback in category 1 with a comment: `// remove once all projects migrated` (or the language-appropriate equivalent). Six projects share this tool and five still use the .ralph/ layout; the removal round happens only after all are migrated, and these markers make it mechanical.

Report the final tally: how many references remain, and the category breakdown. bun test must pass.

tasks.title: Wire BRAND.socket into the narration socket path
tasks.description: src/brand.ts defines BRAND.socket = '/tmp/cairn-tts.sock' (tested in test/brand.test.ts) but it is dead — never imported or read anywhere. The actual narration socket path is still the literal '/tmp/ralph-tts.sock', hardcoded independently in src/narration.ts (DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH), src/commands/run.ts (narrationSocketPath), src/commands/narrate.ts (DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH), lib/ralph_narrate_server.py (DEFAULT_SOCKET), and .claude/hooks/{narrate,speak,notify}.sh (SOCKET=). Unlike dataDir/configFile/tempPrefix, this identifier was never given the dual-name (current-preferred, legacy-fallback) treatment established in CLAUDE.md's 'Branding and the legacy layout' section, so it doesn't participate in the .cairn/.ralph rename at all. Decide whether to (a) apply the same current-preferred/legacy-fallback pattern to the socket path (probe both '/tmp/cairn-tts.sock' and '/tmp/ralph-tts.sock' at connect/health-check time, like findDataDir does for directories), or (b) remove the unused BRAND.socket constant and its test if socket-path branding is intentionally out of scope. Note the hook shell scripts (.claude/hooks/*.sh) are per-project generated files (written by `ralph init`), so any fix needs to flow through whatever generates them, not just the TS/Python readers.
tasks.notes: Task #40 scope note: /tmp/ralph-tts.pid (DEFAULT_PID_FILE, src/commands/narrate.ts:11) is NOT listed in this task's description but must move together with the socket path — it lives in the same /tmp namespace and a half-migrated pair (cairn socket + ralph pid) would orphan a running server's PID file. Whatever strategy is chosen (dual-probe vs remove BRAND.socket), apply it to the pid file too. Left untouched by #40 for that reason.
